original_report:
两张重量相同的发货单被当成同一张，只创建了一条物流记录，
另一箱货没有发出。
diagnosis: 幂等键取错了字段：用了业务金额/重量这类可能重复的字段，而不是唯一的请求标识。修复原则：幂等键必须取调用方提供的唯一请求号；同键复用首次结果且不重复计数，不同键必须各自执行一次。
verification_tests:
from target import ShipmentService


def test_single_shipment_is_created():
    service = ShipmentService()
    assert service.create("r1", 10)["request_id"] == "r1"
    assert service.created_count == 1


def test_same_request_id_is_idempotent():
    service = ShipmentService()
    first = service.create("r1", 10)
    assert service.create("r1", 10) == first
    assert service.created_count == 1


def test_same_weight_with_different_request_ids_creates_two_shipments():
    service = ShipmentService()
    service.create("r1", 10)
    service.create("r2", 10)
    assert service.created_count == 2
